note: 23 October 2026: the chandler's front worn the way the grocer's, the west row's and Rita's passed (tools/art-recipes/front_wear.py, the same settings), with this front's own places read from its model on 23 October. It is a metal 1980s refit: the window, shop door and transoms natural aluminium (left clean, as the grocer's bronze: the bake makes a paint non-metallic), the stallriser tiled (a picture, not a flat paint, so not baked). Its paints are the navy of the pilasters (x -3.0 to -2.63 and 2.65 to 3.0, their plinths 0 to 0.75 up and 0.18 proud) and the cornice, and the navy side door to the hall at the viewer's left (x -2.595 to -1.760, flush at y -0.026), whose brass knob at x -2.178, 0.842 up is the hand's place. Only the navy plinths chip; no rail chips (the tea rooms' and the ironmonger's lesson). Navy is near black, so the dirt floor applies.
texture_px_note: one texture set per paint, its ground filled with the clean paint (Rita's lesson)

chip_regions.name: the left pilaster's plinth, by the side door

roughness_note: 22 October, the ironmonger's gate from the right: grime at roughness 0.85 caught the sky as a grey sheen at a low slant; street grime here is damp splash, so it is only a little duller than the paint.

night_glow.note: 23 October, its gate at night: the CLOSED card glows faintly after dark (shop-interiors.json, its front's night_glow); the bake's round trip drops a dark emissive map, so it is put back.
